{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse with a relaxed fit, cropped at the hip, deep crimson (#DC143C), woven silk.
Tailored wool-blend trousers, straight-leg cut, mid-calf length, charcoal gray (#36454F), fine worsted wool.
Leather ankle boots, pointed toe and low heel, chestnut brown (#8B4513), smooth full-grain leather.
This outfit works for a social gathering with friends in autumn because the rich red top follows her wish to wear red on top while remaining comfortably neat. The charcoal trousers provide a polished yet relaxed silhouette suitable for an evening out without looking too stiff or formal. The ankle boots offer practical warmth and stability for cooler weather while maintaining a stylish edge that balances comfort with elegance."}
